chunks: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah and al-Himyari, together, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother ʿAli ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, from Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Baqir passed away when he was fifty-seven years old, in the year one hundred and fourteen. He lived after ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام for nineteen years and two months.

key_terms.عَامِ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ وَمِائَةٍ: the year one hundred and fourteen
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّل: Imam ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; a reverential expression for death
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْبَاقِرُ: Imam Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Baqir عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: When did Imam Muhammad al-Baqir عليه السلام pass away, and how old was he?
ai.summary: This report records the age and year of the passing of Imam Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Baqir عليه السلام, and the length of his life after Imam ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام. It is a brief biographical narration preserving chronological details about the life of the Imam within the transmitted hadith tradition.

en.hubeali:
Sa’d Bin Abdullah and Al Himeyri, altogether from Ibrahim Bin Mahziyar, from his brother Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali Al-Baqir<sup>asws</sup> passed away and he<sup>asws</sup> was fifty seven years old, during the year one hundred and twenty four. He<sup>asws</sup> lived after Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> for nineteen years and two months’.
en.sarwar: 6. Sa‘d. ibn ‘Abdallah and al-Himyari all have narrated from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother, ali ibn Mhaziyar from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ibn Muskan from abu Basir from abu ‘Abdallah who has said the following. “
Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir passed away at the age of fifty seven, in the year one hundred fourteen AH. He lived for nineteen years and two months after Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.).”
